name: DNAture mixed-breed walking companions and experience choices

provenance.type: Reference-guided mixed-breed walking illustrations converted into native SVG paths; mint-and-ink signpost for guided choice
provenance.method: Distinct walking poses generated from the approved mixed-breed dog and cat references, then traced with vtracer 0.6.15 into ink/mint paths. No embedded bitmap, external dependency, filter or font in the SVGs.

assets.motif: Mixed-breed dog and tabby cat walk right together and exchange a glance beside a mint-and-ink signpost
Tabby cat walks left and mixed-breed dog walks right, calmly exploring independently

usage_rules: Both experiences support cats and dogs. The guided pair walks together; the exploration pair parts calmly in opposite directions.
Preserve the approved mixed-breed dog and cat identities, natural walking gait, and intended directions.
Keep the experience name visible beside the artwork; the illustration does not replace the control label.
Use empty alt when the adjacent control already supplies the experience name.
Place directly on a continuous light surface. Preserve the 4:3 experience canvas and the intrinsic ratio of standalone pairs.
Do not add cards, circular masks, shadows, or category colors.
Use only ink and mint in these illustrations. Do not add dotted paths, stars, compasses, or orange accents.
The artwork is static. Any UI reveal must honor reduced motion.
